name: Show parent task sub taslks in the new task dialog
description:
Here's a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. Added a list of the parent task's children (not yet in the sprint) to the New Task/Subtask modal in `SprintBoardModals.vue`.
2. Centralized sprint inheritance in `src/store/chats.js` (`createNewChat`): a child chat with a `parent_id` and no own `sprints` now inherits its parent's sprints.
3. Aligned `src/store/kanban.js`: `newSprintTask` gives subtasks the parent's sprints while root tasks fall back to the active sprint board.
4. Changed the modal's "Existing subtasks" rows from accumulating checkboxes to click-to-select rows that add the child to the sprint immediately.
5. Selecting a child now emits `tasks-added` (single id) and closes the dialog via `closeNewTask`, while the manual "Create" flow remains unchanged.
